description: Auditor General's Department - Amendment to Para. 6(i) of the Minute on the Audit Examiner's Service Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord.No. 380/61 of 20.12.1985 and that will be effective from 11.09.2007
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns an amendment to the service minute for Audit Examiners, specifically regarding promotion qualifications. This falls under public sector administration, specifically service conditions and regulations for government employees, which is the domain of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). The content is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals with administrative rules for a specific public service cadre, not with government structure, personnel appointments, or any of the other specialized categories.
